# Offline test fixtures

`final_outputs/*.txt` are synthetic examples of the existing labeled output
contract. They are not saved identifications, accuracy evidence, or real research
results. The familiar brand/model in the jeans fixture supports existing numeric
product-name regression assertions. No user images, credentials, sessions, or
live response envelopes are included. Test images are generated in memory.

These replace the offline suite's dependency on four private Milestone 1 final
texts in `data/integration/`. Live QA scripts still require the original private
fixtures and running local services; they are not clean-checkout regression tests.
